devices.description: Registered ESP32 IoT Nodes and tank metadata

fields.pumpOnPercent: number (Water level percentage trigger to start refill)
fields.pumpOffPercent: number (Water level percentage trigger to stop refill)
fields.pumpFlowRateLpm: number (Pump flow rate in liters per minute)
fields.pumpPowerWatts: number (Motor electrical rating in Watts for kWh math)
fields.electricityCostPerKWh: number (Local power tariff for cost estimation)
fields.autoMode: boolean (Whether cloud/ESP32 logic automatically triggers relay)
fields.leakDetectionThresholdLph: number (Litres/hour drop rate considered an anomaly)
